title: Which path remains open?
hook: Treatment and outcome share an upstream cause. Trace both routes.

knows: arithmetic means, rates and simple plotted values
doesNotKnow: trace every non-causal path from treatment to outcome before the app reveals them.

claims.text: Let independent fair Z,U generate T=Z+U and Y=2T+3Z. What outcome change follows increasing T by one while holding Z fixed?
claims.source: src/demos/probability/p100-find-the-backdoor/spec.ts; exact finite illustration specified in manager numericCase: DAG Z→T,Z→Y,T→Y with T=Z+U,Y=2T+3Z. Compare observed mean difference with Z path open and standardized difference after balancing Z. Toy Z,U independent binary; causal unit effect2.
